```{r lib_load}
library(tidyverse)   # data wrangling & ggplot2
library(janitor)     # functions for examining and cleaning dirty data
library(kableExtra)  # simple table generator
library(here)        # Find files within a project
library(olsrr)       # package for p-value backward elimination
library(broom)       # summarizes key information about models
library(rlang)       # functions for Base Types and Core R and 'Tidyverse' Features
library(car)         # VIF, influence measures helpers
library(scales)      # provides the internal scaling infrastructure used by ggplot
```

```{r fun, results='hide'}
codf    <- readRDS(file = here("rmds/modfunctions", "codfunctions.rds"))
codform <- readRDS(file = here("rmds", "codformulas.rds"))
codf_env <- list2env(codf, parent = globalenv())
for (nm in names(codf)) {environment(codf[[nm]]) <- codf_env}
list2env(codf, envir = codf_env)
source(here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/d2325f", "spss_cod_district-7_23-25f.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
source(here("rmds/cod2325/districtruns/d2325f", "spss_cod_district-5_23-25f.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r setup1}
data_path <- here("data/city", "CCD5_2023-2025_Data.sav")  
ecf_keep <- NULL       # Optional: add ECF filters here if needed, e.g. c("1R101", "1R102")
base_ecf <- "5r507"    # Base ECF in the SPSS syntax
cook_case_count <- 649
forced_terms <- character(0)
```

```{r prepdata}
#df <- read_sav(data_path) |> rename_with(tolower)    # Load data
load(file = here("data/rdata", "cod_2023-2025geo.RData"))

df <- sales_df |> filter(ccd == 5)

dfspss <- read_csv(here("data/spss", "spssmods.csv"))
#dfsps <- read_csv(here("data/spss", "CCD5_2023_2025_coefficients_extracted5.csv"))
dfsps <- read_csv(here("data/spss", "spsscos.csv"))
df <- df %>% filter(ccd == 5)    # Equivalent to: SELECT IF CCD=1.
if (!is.null(ecf_keep)) {df <- df %>% filter(ecf %in% ecf_keep)}    # Optional ECF filter block
ecf_source_col <- detect_ecf_col(df)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    ecf = tolower(trimws(as.character(.data[[ecf_source_col]]))),
    priceclass = case_when(
      saleprice < 48000 ~ 1L, saleprice >= 48000 & saleprice < 67000 ~ 2L,
      saleprice >= 67000 & saleprice < 94000 ~ 3L,
      saleprice >= 94000 & saleprice < 134000 ~ 4L, saleprice >= 134000 ~ 5L, TRUE ~ 0L
    )
  )

df <- df %>%    # Record filtering
  mutate(
    inn = ifelse(sresb_style %in% c("SINGLE FAMILY", "1/2 DUPLEX", "ROW HOUSE"), 1L, 0L)
  ) %>% filter(inn == 1)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    out = ifelse(
      stotalsqft < 400 |
      sresb_floorarea < 400 |
      saleprice < 10000,
      1L, 0L
    )
  ) %>% filter(out == 0)
# Remove duplicates: SPSS kept the "last" record by parcelno, saleprice, saledate
df <- df %>%
  mutate(saledate_parsed = parse_sale_date(saledate)) %>%
  arrange(parcelno, saleprice, saledate_parsed) %>%
  group_by(parcelno, saleprice, saledate) %>%
  mutate(primarylast = if_else(row_number() == n(), 1L, 0L)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(primarylast == 1)

df <- df %>%    # Remove likely non-market sales where sale price ~= assessment
  mutate(
    priceisasmt_ratio = avwhensold / saleprice,
    priceisasmt_ratio2 = ifelse(priceisasmt_ratio >= 0.90 & priceisasmt_ratio <= 1.10, 1, priceisasmt_ratio),
    priceisasmt_ratio = priceisasmt_ratio2, priceisasmt = ifelse(priceisasmt_ratio == 1, 0L, 1L)
  ) %>% filter(priceisasmt == 1)
# Setup calculations
df <- df %>% mutate(ratio = sesttcv / saleprice, sppsf = saleprice / sresb_floorarea)
# Categorical binary transformations
df <- df %>%    # Style-height buckets
  mutate(
    onestory      = ifelse(sresb_styhgt <= 2, 1L, 0L),
    twostory      = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 2 & sresb_styhgt <= 5, 1L, 0L),
    twoplusstory  = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 5 & sresb_styhgt <= 8, 1L, 0L),
    bilevelsplit  = ifelse(sresb_styhgt > 8 & sresb_styhgt <= 10, 1L, 0L),
    check = onestory + twostory + twoplusstory + bilevelsplit,
    single_family1story = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & onestory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    single_family2story = ifelse(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex1story   = ifelse(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & onestory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    half_duplex2story   = ifelse(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L),
    row_house2story = if_else(sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE" & twostory == 1, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Building eras
  mutate(
    erabuilt = case_when(
      sresb_yearbuilt < 1910 ~ 1L, sresb_yearbuilt >= 1910 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1930 ~ 2L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1930 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1946 ~ 3L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1946 & sresb_yearbuilt < 1961 ~ 4L,
      sresb_yearbuilt >= 1961 & sresb_yearbuilt <= 1990 ~ 5L,
      sresb_yearbuilt > 1990 ~ 6L, TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    yb_pre_1910 = ifelse(erabuilt == 1, 1L, 0L), yb_1910_to_1929 = ifelse(erabuilt == 2, 1L, 0L),
    yb_1930_to_1945 = ifelse(erabuilt == 3, 1L, 0L), yb_1961_to_1990 = ifelse(erabuilt == 5, 1L, 0L),
    yb_post_1990 = ifelse(erabuilt == 6, 1L, 0L), yb_1946_to_1960 = if_else(erabuilt == 4L, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Condition
  mutate(
    good = ifelse(scond == 2, 1L, 0L), fair = ifelse(scond == 4, 1L, 0L),
    poor = ifelse(scond == 5, 1L, 0L), unsound = ifelse(scond == 7, 1L, 0L),
    cavg = ifelse(scond == 3, 1L, 0L), excellent = if_else(scond == 0, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Bathrooms
  mutate(
    two_baths        = ifelse(sresb_fullbaths == 2, 1L, 0L),
    three_plus_baths = ifelse(sresb_fullbaths %in% 3:10, 1L, 0L),
    powder_room      = ifelse(sresb_halfbaths %in% 1:5, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>% mutate(fireplace = ifelse(sresb_fireplace %in% 1:6, 1L, 0L))    # Fireplace

df <- df %>%    # Basement/crawl/slab
  mutate(
    pctcrawl = sresb_crawspace / sresb_groundarea, pctslab = sresb_slabarea / sresb_groundarea,
    pctbsmnt = sresb_basementarea / sresb_groundarea,
    crawl    = ifelse(pctcrawl > pctbsmnt & pctcrawl > pctslab, 1L, 0L),
    slab     = ifelse(pctslab > pctcrawl & pctslab > pctbsmnt, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Building class
  mutate(
    qbest      = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 5, 1L, 0L), qavg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 2, 1L, 0L),
    qabove_avg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass %in% c(3, 4), 1L, 0L),
    qbelow_avg = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 1, 1L, 0L), qpoor = ifelse(sresb_bldgclass == 0, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Exterior (brick is base)
  mutate(
    ext_brick_siding = if_else(sresb_exterior == 17, 1L, 0L),
    ext_other = if_else(!(sresb_exterior %in% c(3, 17)) & !is.na(sresb_exterior), 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Garages
  mutate(
    garage = ifelse(sresb_garagearea >= 200, 1L, 0L),
    garagespaces = case_when(
      sresb_garagearea > 200 & sresb_garagearea < 420 ~ 1,
      sresb_garagearea > 419 & sresb_garagearea < 600 ~ 2,
      sresb_garagearea > 599 & sresb_garagearea < 820 ~ 3, sresb_garagearea > 819 ~ 4, TRUE ~ 0
    ), ln_garagespaces = safe_log(garagespaces)
  )

df <- df %>% mutate(arterial = ifelse(rd_class %in% c("A21", "A31"), 1L, 0L))    # Road class

df <- df %>%    # Heating/cooling
  mutate(
    hot_water = ifelse(sresb_heat == 2, 1L, 0L), elec_baseboard = ifelse(sresb_heat == 3, 1L, 0L),
    wall = ifelse(sresb_heat %in% c(6, 8), 1L, 0L), central_air = ifelse(sresb_heat == 9, 1L, 0L)
  )
# Size buckets # NOTE: The SPSS syntax uses "< 12666" for size=3, which looks like a typo.
# Here I use 1266 because that is consistent with the other cutpoints.
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    size = case_when(
      sresb_floorarea < 830 ~ 1L, sresb_floorarea >= 830 & sresb_floorarea < 1018 ~ 2L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1018 & sresb_floorarea < 1266 ~ 3L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1266 & sresb_floorarea < 1659 ~ 4L,
      sresb_floorarea >= 1659 ~ 5L, TRUE ~ 0L
    ),
    smallest = ifelse(size == 1, 1L, 0L), small = ifelse(size == 2, 1L, 0L),
    large    = ifelse(size == 4, 1L, 0L), largest = ifelse(size == 5, 1L, 0L)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Time analysis setup
  mutate(
    smonth = month(saledate_parsed), syear = year(saledate_parsed),
    months = case_when(
      syear == 2023 ~ smonth - 3, syear == 2024 ~ smonth + 9,
      syear == 2025 ~ smonth + 21, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
# NOTE: # The SPSS syntax says:
#   RECODE scond (4=1)(ELSE=0) INTO average. # Earlier value labels say 3 = Average and 4 = Fair.
# To preserve the SPSS text exactly, use scond == 4 below.
df2 <- df %>% mutate(average = ifelse(scond == 4, 1L, 0L))

df_avg <- df2 %>% filter(average == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    sppsf = saleprice / sresb_floorarea, months_1to9 = pmin(months, 9),
    months_10to18 = case_when(
      months > 9  & months <= 18 ~ months - 9, months > 18 ~ 9, TRUE ~ 0
    ), months_19to24 = case_when(months > 18 ~ months - 18, TRUE ~ 0),
    months_10to16 = case_when(months > 16 ~ 7, months > 9 ~ months - 9, TRUE ~ 0),
    months_17to24 = if_else(months > 16, months - 16, 0), ln_sppsf = safe_log(sppsf)
  )

df <- df %>%    # Add time spline vars to full data too
  mutate(
    months_1to9 = pmin(months, 9), months_10to24 = if_else(months > 9, months - 9, 0),
    months_10to18 = case_when(
      months > 9  & months <= 18 ~ months - 9, months > 18 ~ 9, TRUE ~ 0
    ), months_19to24 = case_when(months > 18 ~ months - 18, TRUE ~ 0),
    months_10to16 = case_when(months > 16 ~ 7, months > 9 ~ months - 9, TRUE ~ 0),
    months_17to24 = if_else(months > 16, months - 16, 0), ln_sppsf = safe_log(sppsf)
  )
# Size / lot / land transformations
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    lnsbldsf = safe_log(sresb_floorarea), sbldsfint = sresb_floorarea - 540,
    lnsbldsfint = safe_log(sresb_floorarea - 540), sbldsfmed = sresb_floorarea - 1575,
    lnsbldsfmed = safe_log(sresb_floorarea - 1575),
    bsz_single = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY", 1L, 0L),
    bsz_halfduplex = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX", 1L, 0L),
    bsz_row = if_else(sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE", 1L, 0L),
    base_bldgsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 1573, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" ~ 2095,
      sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE" ~ 1916, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),  base_bldgsize_ratio = sresb_floorarea / base_bldgsize,
    ln_base_bldgsize_ratio = safe_log(base_bldgsize_ratio),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_row = if_else(sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_single = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0),
    ln_sbldsf_bsz_halfduplex = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX", ln_base_bldgsize_ratio, 0),
    lsz_row = if_else(sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE", 1L, 0L),
    lsz_single = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY", 1L, 0L),
    lsz_halfduplex = if_else(sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX", 1L, 0L),
    base_lotsize = case_when(
      sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" ~ 4138, sresb_style == "1/2 DUPLEX" ~ 4954,
      sresb_style == "ROW HOUSE" ~ 1817, TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),  base_lotsize_ratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize,
    ln_base_lotsize_ratio = safe_log(base_lotsize_ratio),
    landratio = stotalsqft / base_lotsize, landratio2 = landratio,
    landratio2 = if_else(landratio >= 0.90 & landratio <= 1.10, 1, landratio2),
    landratio2 = if_else(sresb_style != "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio > 3, 3, landratio2),
    landratio2 = if_else(sresb_style == "SINGLE FAMILY" & landratio > 4, 4, landratio2),
    ln_landratio = safe_log(landratio2), ln_price = safe_log(saleprice)
  )
```

---

## Model I

```{r mod1}
time_terms <- c(
  "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story", "row_house2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "excellent", "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qbest", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg", "qpoor",
  "ext_brick_siding", "ext_other",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "wall", "central_air",
  "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24", "near_downtown_1mi", "near_downtown_5mi"
)

time_formula <- reformulate(time_terms, response = "ln_sppsf")

time_df <- df %>% filter(cavg == 1)

#mod_time_initial <- backward_pss(time_formula, data = time_df, p_out = 0.10, keep_terms = forced_terms)

mod_time <- backward_pss(time_formula, data = time_df, p_out = 0.10, verbose = TRUE) # df_avg

#model_summary_tbl(mod_time)
```

```{r src1}
rmt <- model_metrics_c(mod_time, digits = 4)
smod1 <- dfspss |> filter(spssmod == "ccd5mod1") |> select(df_total:f_stat)

res <- make_metrics_kable(spss_df = smod1, r_df = rmt,
  caption = "District 5 | LN\\_SPPSF Model Fit Statistics: SPSS vs R", latex = TRUE
)
res$kable
```

```{r coef1}
spsmod1 <- dfsps |> filter(codd == 5 & model == 1) |> select(model:sig) |>
  mutate(term = trimws(tolower(term)), term = ifelse(term == "(constant)", "(intercept)", term))

m1c <- make_coeff_compare_tabl(
  model = mod_time, spss_df = spsmod1, include_intercept = TRUE, intercept_first = TRUE,
  digits = 3, caption = "District 5 | Model I Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R"
)

m1c$kable
```

```{r rbs1, eval=FALSE}
spsmod1a <- spsmod1
spsmod1a$term <- tolower(spsmod1$term)
res_compare1 <- codf$plot_beta_compare_lollipops(
  model = mod_time, df = spsmod1a, df_term_col = "term", df_beta_col = "beta",
  include_ecf = FALSE, model_label = "R", df_label = "SPSS",
  title = "District 5 | Model I Beta Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R"
)
res_compare1$plot
```

```{r timeadj1}
dfrate1 <- make_time_adjusted_df(df, mod_time, time_formula)

df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rate1_initial = dfrate1$rate1, rate2_initial = dfrate1$rate2,
    price_index_initial = dfrate1$price_index, end_index_initial = dfrate1$end_index,
    taf_initial = dfrate1$taf, tasp_initial = dfrate1$tasp,
    tasppsf_initial = dfrate1$tasppsf, ln_tasp_initial = dfrate1$ln_tasp
  )
```

```{r mod2}
no_ecf_terms <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio",
  "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story", "row_house2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
```

## Model III

```{r mod3}
base_terms <- c(
  "ln_landratio", "ln_base_bldgsize_ratio",
  "arterial",
  "single_family1story", "half_duplex1story", "half_duplex2story", "row_house2story",
  "smallest", "small", "large", "largest",
  "two_baths", "three_plus_baths", "powder_room",
  "excellent", "good", "fair", "poor", "unsound",
  "qbest", "qabove_avg", "qbelow_avg", "qpoor",
  "ext_brick_siding", "ext_other",
  "yb_pre_1910", "yb_1930_to_1945", "yb_1946_to_1960", "yb_1961_to_1990", "yb_post_1990",
  "crawl", "slab",
  "ln_garagespaces", "fireplace",
  "hot_water", "wall", "central_air",
  ecf_terms,
  "months_1to9", "months_10to16", "months_17to24", "near_downtown_1mi", "near_downtown_5mi"
)

base_formula <- reformulate(base_terms, response = "ln_price")
mod_1 <- backward_pss(base_formula, data = df, p_out = 0.10)

df <- add_influence_metrics(df, mod_1, run_id = 1)

df <- df %>% mutate(esp1 = exp(pre_1), ratio1 = esp1 / saleprice)

#model_summary_tbl(mod_1)

rmetrics3 <- codf$spss_ratio_metrics(df, esp1, saleprice)
rmetrics3a <- rmetrics3 |> select(median_ratio:PRB)
```

```{r src31}
rmt <- model_metrics_c(mod_1, digits = 4)
smod3a <- dfspss |> filter(spssmod == "ccd5mod3") |> select(df_total:f_stat)
res <- make_metrics_kable(spss_df = smod3a, r_df = rmt,
  caption = "District 5 | LN\\_PRICE Model Fit Statistics: SPSS vs R", latex = TRUE
)
res$kable
```

```{r src32}
smod3b <- dfspss |> filter(spssmod == "ccd5mod3") |> select(median_ratio:PRB)
res <- make_metrics_kable(spss_df = smod3b, r_df = rmetrics3a,
  caption = "District 5 | LN\\_PRICE Model Assessing Statistics: SPSS vs R", latex = TRUE
)
res$kable
```

```{r coef3, eval=FALSE}
spsmod3 <- dfsps |> filter(codd == 5 & model == 3) |> select(model:sig) |>
  mutate(term = trimws(tolower(term)), term = ifelse(term == "(constant)", "(intercept)", term))

m3c <- make_coeff_compare_tabl(
  model = mod_1, spss_df = spsmod3, include_intercept = TRUE, intercept_first = TRUE,
  digits = 3, caption = "District 5 | Model III Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R"
)

m3c$kable
```

```{r cf3}
spsmod3 <- dfsps |> filter(codd == 5 & model == 3) |> select(model:vif) |>
  mutate(term = trimws(tolower(term)), term = ifelse(term == "(constant)", "(intercept)", term))

tables3 <- compare_metrics_kables2(
  mod = mod_1, spss_df = spsmod3, 
  caption1 = "District 5 | Model III Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R", 
  caption2 = "District 5 | Model III Coefficient Comparison: SPSS vs R", digits = 4
```

```{r functionstwo, eval=FALSE}
make_coeff_df <- function(model, model_name = "Model 1", include_intercept = TRUE,
                          standardized_beta = TRUE, digits = NULL) {
  if (!inherits(model, "lm")) {stop("`model` must be an lm object.")}
  sm <- summary(model)
  coef_mat <- as.data.frame(sm$coefficients, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  if (ncol(coef_mat) < 4) {stop("Unexpected coefficient matrix structure.")}
  names(coef_mat)[1:4] <- c("b", "std_error", "t", "sig")
  coef_mat$term <- rownames(coef_mat)
  rownames(coef_mat) <- NULL
  dep_var <- all.vars(formula(model))[1]
  coef_mat$beta <- NA_real_    # Standardized beta
  if (standardized_beta) {
    mf <- model.frame(model)
    y <- model.response(mf)
    X <- model.matrix(model)
    sdy <- stats::sd(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (is.finite(sdy) && sdy > 0) {
      sdx <- apply(X, 2, stats::sd, na.rm = TRUE)
      b_vec <- stats::coef(model)
      common_terms <- intersect(names(b_vec), colnames(X))
      beta_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(b_vec))
      names(beta_vals) <- names(b_vec)
      beta_vals[common_terms] <- b_vec[common_terms] * sdx[common_terms] / sdy
      coef_mat$beta <- unname(beta_vals[coef_mat$term])
    }
  }
  out <- data.frame(model = model_name, dependent_variable = dep_var, term = coef_mat$term,
    b = coef_mat$b, std_error = coef_mat$std_error, beta = coef_mat$beta,
    t = coef_mat$t, sig = coef_mat$sig, stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (!include_intercept) {out <- out[out$term != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]}
  if (!is.null(digits)) {
    num_cols <- c("b", "std_error", "beta", "t", "sig")
    out[num_cols] <- lapply(out[num_cols], round, digits = digits)
  }
  out
}

make_coeff_kable <- function(
    model, spss_df, model_name = "Model 1", spss_label = "SPSS", r_label = "R",
    impact_by = c("beta", "t", "b"), include_intercept = FALSE,
    caption = "SPSS vs R Coefficient Comparison", latex = TRUE, digits = 4,
    pct_digits = 2, max_pct_for_red = 10, beta_if_missing = TRUE
) {
  impact_by <- match.arg(impact_by)

  if (!inherits(model, "lm")) stop("`model` must be an lm object.")
  if (!is.data.frame(spss_df)) stop("`spss_df` must be a data.frame.")
  if (!exists("make_coeff_df", mode = "function")) {
    stop("`make_coeff_df()` was not found. Define it first before calling `make_coeff_kable()`." )
  }
  if (!requireNamespace("dplyr", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'dplyr' is required.")
  if (!requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) stop("Package 'knitr' is required.")

  format_type <- if (latex) "latex" else "html"

  r_df <- make_coeff_df(model = model, model_name = model_name,
    include_intercept = include_intercept, standardized_beta = beta_if_missing, digits = NULL
  )
  # normalize SPSS columns if extra fields are present
  needed_cols <- c("model", "dependent_variable", "term", "b", "std_error", "beta", "t", "sig")
  missing_needed <- setdiff(c("term", "b", "std_error", "t", "sig"), names(spss_df))
  if (length(missing_needed) > 0) {
    stop("`spss_df` is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_needed, collapse = ", "))
  }

  for (nm in setdiff(needed_cols, names(spss_df))) {spss_df[[nm]] <- NA}
  spss_df <- spss_df[, needed_cols, drop = FALSE]
  if (!include_intercept) {spss_df <- spss_df[spss_df$term != "(Intercept)", , drop = FALSE]}
  # join SPSS and R outputs side-by-side
  cmp <- dplyr::full_join(
    spss_df %>% dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_spss"), -term),
    r_df    %>% dplyr::rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_r"), -term),
    by = "term"
  )

  pct_diff_one <- function(r_val, spss_val) {
    if (is.na(r_val) || is.na(spss_val)) return(NA_real_)
    if (spss_val == 0) {
      if (r_val == 0) return(0)
      return(NA_real_)
    }
    ((r_val - spss_val) / abs(spss_val)) * 100
  }

  compare_metrics <- c("b", "std_error", "beta", "t", "sig")
  available_metrics <- compare_metrics[
    paste0(compare_metrics, "_spss") %in% names(cmp) & paste0(compare_metrics, "_r") %in% names(cmp)
  ]

  for (nm in available_metrics) {
    cmp[[paste0(nm, "_pct_diff")]] <- mapply(
      pct_diff_one,
      cmp[[paste0(nm, "_r")]],
      cmp[[paste0(nm, "_spss")]]
    )
  }

  # impact ranking: prefer abs(beta_r), else abs(t_r), else abs(b_r)
  impact_candidates <- switch(
    impact_by,
    beta = c("beta_r", "beta_spss", "t_r", "t_spss", "b_r", "b_spss"),
    t    = c("t_r", "t_spss", "beta_r", "beta_spss", "b_r", "b_spss"),
    b    = c("b_r", "b_spss", "t_r", "t_spss", "beta_r", "beta_spss")
  )

  impact_source <- impact_candidates[impact_candidates %in% names(cmp)][1]
  if (is.na(impact_source) || length(impact_source) == 0) {
    cmp$impact_value <- NA_real_
  } else {
    cmp$impact_value <- abs(cmp[[impact_source]])
  }

  cmp <- cmp %>%
    dplyr::mutate(term = as.character(term), impact_rank_source = impact_source) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(impact_value), term)

  # tidy display columns
  display_cols <- c(
    "term",
    "b_spss", "b_r", "b_pct_diff",
    "std_error_spss", "std_error_r", "std_error_pct_diff",
    "beta_spss", "beta_r", "beta_pct_diff",
    "t_spss", "t_r", "t_pct_diff",
    "sig_spss", "sig_r", "sig_pct_diff"
  )
  display_cols <- intersect(display_cols, names(cmp))
  out_df <- cmp[, c("term", setdiff(display_cols, "term")), drop = FALSE]
  # create a human-friendly percent-difference summary row
  summary_row <- as.list(rep(NA, ncol(out_df)))
  names(summary_row) <- names(out_df)
  summary_row[["term"]] <- "% diff summary (median abs % diff)"

  pct_cols <- grep("_pct_diff$", names(out_df), value = TRUE)
  for (nm in pct_cols) {
    vals <- abs(out_df[[nm]])
    summary_row[[nm]] <- if (all(is.na(vals))) NA_real_ else stats::median(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  out_df_with_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(out_df, as.data.frame(summary_row, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))

  if (!requireNamespace("kableExtra", quietly = TRUE)) {
    kb <- knitr::kable(
      out_df_with_summary, caption = paste0(caption, " (ordered by impact: ", impact_source, ")"),
      digits = digits, format = format_type, booktabs = latex
    )
    return(list(data = out_df_with_summary, kable = kb))
  }

  diff_to_color <- function(x, max_pct = max_pct_for_red) {
    out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
    ok <- !is.na(x) & is.finite(x)
    if (!any(ok)) return(out)
    scaled <- pmin(pmax(abs(x[ok]) / max_pct, 0), 1)
    ramp_mat <- grDevices::colorRamp(c("#1a9850", "#fee08b", "#d73027"))(scaled)
    out[ok] <- grDevices::rgb(
      ramp_mat[, 1],
      ramp_mat[, 2],
      ramp_mat[, 3],
      maxColorValue = 255
    )
    out
  }

  display_df <- out_df_with_summary
  # format non-percent numeric columns
  numeric_cols <- names(display_df)[vapply(display_df, is.numeric, logical(1))]
  non_pct_numeric_cols <- setdiff(numeric_cols, pct_cols)
  for (nm in non_pct_numeric_cols) {
    vals <- display_df[[nm]]
    display_df[[nm]] <- ifelse(is.na(vals), "", formatC(vals, digits = digits, format = "f"))
  }
  # format and color percent diff columns
  for (nm in pct_cols) {
    raw_vals <- out_df_with_summary[[nm]]
    colors <- diff_to_color(raw_vals)
    display_vals <- ifelse(is.na(raw_vals), "", paste0(formatC(raw_vals, digits = pct_digits, format = "f"), "%"))

    display_df[[nm]] <- mapply(
      function(txt, col) {
        if (is.na(col) || identical(col, NA_character_) || identical(txt, "")) return(txt)
        kableExtra::cell_spec(txt, format = format_type, background = col, color = "black")
      },
      display_vals,
      colors,
      SIMPLIFY = FALSE,
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  }
  # also color the R-value columns based on their associated pct diff columns
  metric_pairs <- list(
    b = c("b_r", "b_pct_diff"), std_error = c("std_error_r", "std_error_pct_diff"),
    beta = c("beta_r", "beta_pct_diff"), t = c("t_r", "t_pct_diff"),
    sig = c("sig_r", "sig_pct_diff")
  )

  for (pair in metric_pairs) {
    r_col <- pair[1]
    p_col <- pair[2]
    if (!(r_col %in% names(display_df) && p_col %in% names(out_df_with_summary))) next

    raw_diff <- out_df_with_summary[[p_col]]
    colors <- diff_to_color(raw_diff)
    raw_r_vals <- out_df_with_summary[[r_col]]
    txt_r_vals <- ifelse(is.na(raw_r_vals), "", formatC(raw_r_vals, digits = digits, format = "f"))

    display_df[[r_col]] <- mapply(
      function(txt, col) {
        if (is.na(col) || identical(col, NA_character_) || identical(txt, "")) return(txt)
        kableExtra::cell_spec(txt, format = format_type, background = col, color = "black")
      },
      txt_r_vals,
      colors,
      SIMPLIFY = FALSE,
      USE.NAMES = FALSE
    )
  }

  kb <- knitr::kable(
    display_df, caption = paste0(caption, " (ordered by impact: ", impact_source, ")"),
    format = format_type, digits = digits, booktabs = latex, escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(
      latex_options = if (latex) c("hold_position", "striped", "scale_down") else NULL,
      full_width = FALSE
    ) %>% kableExtra::row_spec(nrow(display_df), bold = TRUE)

  list(data = out_df_with_summary, kable = kb)
}

```

```{r comod4, eval=FALSE}
coef_data <- tidy(mod_4) %>% filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>% filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>% arrange(desc(estimate))

# Add conditional styling to the estimate column
formatted_data <- coef_data %>%
  mutate(    # Round the estimate for cleaner display
    estimate_clean = round(estimate, 3),    # Apply green for positive, red for negative
    estimate_styled = cell_spec(
      estimate_clean, color = "black",
      background = ifelse(estimate > 0, "#28a745", "#dc3545"),  bold = TRUE
    ),    # Round p-values for a cleaner table
    p.value = round(p.value, 4)
  ) %>% select(term, estimate_styled, std.error, statistic, p.value)
formatted_data <- formatted_data %>% mutate(term = str_replace_all(term, "_", "\\\\_"))

kable(
  formatted_data,  format = "latex", # Change to "latex" if knitting to PDF
  escape = FALSE,  # Crucial for rendering the cell_spec colors
  col.names = c("Predictor", "Influence on Sale Price", "Std. Error", "t-statistic", "p-value"),
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"), booktabs = TRUE
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), full_width = FALSE
  ) %>% row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```
